The '''maggot-cyborgs of Hydra''' were a group of individuals that once threatened [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]], but were beaten back by the efforts of the [[Trianii Rangers]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> They originated from the [[Hydra system/Legends|Hydra system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=maggot-cyborgs of Hydra|system=[[Hydra system/Legends|Hydra system]]|legends=1}}</ref>
